# how-to-web

> A visual and machine-readable web reference for humans and coding agents. how-to-web teaches what web building blocks are, how to review them, and how to reconstruct them from portable Build DNA.

Use the most specific `llms.txt` available for a component path. Build DNA is the primary machine-readable reconstruction contract; examples are demonstrations, not specifications.

## Components

- [Product Card](./blocks/product-card/index.md): Human/agent reference for a product-listing card.
- [Product Card Build DNA](./blocks/product-card/build-dna.json): Canonical reconstruction contract.
- [Product Card llms.txt](./blocks/product-card/llms.txt): Component-specific agent guidance.
- [Navbar](./elements/navigation/navbar/index.md): Human/agent reference for global site navigation.
- [Navbar Build DNA](./elements/navigation/navbar/build-dna.json): Canonical Navbar reconstruction contract.
- [Navbar llms.txt](./elements/navigation/navbar/llms.txt): Navbar-specific agent guidance.
- [Carousel](./elements/interactive/carousel/index.md): Human/agent reference for controlled content sequences.
- [Carousel Build DNA](./elements/interactive/carousel/build-dna.json): Canonical Carousel reconstruction contract.
- [Carousel llms.txt](./elements/interactive/carousel/llms.txt): Carousel-specific agent guidance.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/blame76/how-to-web): Source, research and architecture documentation.
